accepted_obligation: SHARED: bind the first missing x-to-(G,K) operation of REQ-0009 before constructing or attacking downstream coordinates/routes
inherited_contracts: Both theorem directions use the same fixed encoding and deterministic model
n=|x| in bits; representation-local size is not substituted for n
No supplied witness, route advice, or external file payload is hidden outside x
Stop at the first unsupported bridge
needed_inputs: An authoritative existing codec artifact and revision, or a decision selecting one shared codec
Finite byte grammar for one self-contained x encoding original IDs, all vertices including isolates, conflict pairs, and K
Valid-input rules and the treatment of invalid encodings
Deterministic decoding operations and bit-work model
requested_parts: Pin Gamma's byte grammar and deterministic decoder without silently replacing an existing authorized codec
Define L_Gamma on byte strings, including malformed input behavior
Show every finite simple graph and nonnegative K is representable; preserve original-ID reconstruction
Charge encoding/decoding, validation, identity mapping, and graph construction in n=|x| bits
Prove the relation between decoded vertex/edge/ID sizes and encoded input length
Record the selected codec in the shared authority chain; then resume the existing REQ-0009 rather than starting a different theorem route
counterprobes: The charter's requirement for a shared encoding is mistaken for a supplied decoder
External CSV paths or supplied graph objects are mistaken for x alone
Duplicate identities, unknown endpoints, isolates, K=0, K>|V|, empty graphs, and malformed input silently alter graph semantics
Decoded graph size or ID operations are unit-cost without a bit-length bound
FAST_VERIFY(x,y), KNOWN_ROUTE, or FLOAT64_OR_PATH_REPRESENTATION is promoted to a polynomial decider
A newly proposed codec is mislabeled as the repository's previously fixed encoding
acceptance_criteria: One authoritative codec is explicitly pinned for both theorem directions
One deterministic x-only decoder has unambiguous validity/identity/edge/K behavior
All decoded-size conversions and decoder costs are explicit in the fixed bit model
A codec or decoder is admitted only as a substrate component, never as the requested decider
No downstream coordinate, selector, or universal-runtime claim is promoted at this bridge
output_contract: Return the recovered or selected shared codec, exact deterministic decoder specification, and charged size/cost relation; otherwise retain the encoded-input bridge as UNRESOLVED. The checkpoint's JSON and framed-CSV suggestions are unadopted proposals.
remainder: REQ-0009 remains uninstantiated on encoded x. Coordinate construction, route selection, terminal decision, witness construction, and complete lifecycle recurrence resume only after this first binding is supplied.
